Ku-$25^\circ\text{C}$ kanye no-$1\text{ atm}$, ivolumu yemolar yegesi ingu-$24.5\text{ L/mol}$. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanayo, yini ivolumu ku-$\text{L}$ ye-$0.2\text{ mol}$ yale gesi?
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.steps.0.explain:
Isinyathelo 1: Ngokomthetho ka-Avogadro, ivolumu $V = n \times V_m$.
Isinyathelo 2: $V = 0.2\text{ mol} \times 24.5\text{ L/mol}$.
Isinyathelo 3: Ukubala kunikeza u-$V = 4.90\text{ L}$.

20261122-chemistry-g06-2.title: Acids and Bases
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.goal: Sebenzisa izimiso ze-Acids and Bases ukuxazulula inkinga yophenyo.
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.material: [E6 Uphenyo Lwekhemistri (Okuthuthukile)] Inkinga yokuhlaziya ubungako mayelana ne-Acids and Bases. Isixazululo se-asidi $A$ sinokusansimbi $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ kanti isixazululo $B$ sino-$[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Kaphindwe kangaki ukugcwala kwe-ion ye-hydrogen ku-$A$ kukhulu kune-B?
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.s.s1.prompt: [E6 Uphenyo Lwekhemistri (Okuthuthukile)] Inkinga yokuhlaziya ubungako mayelana ne-Acids and Bases. Isixazululo se-asidi $A$ sinokusansimbi $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ kanti isixazululo $B$ sino-$[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Kaphindwe kangaki ukugcwala kwe-ion ye-hydrogen ku-$A$ kukhulu kune-B?
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.s.s1.explain:
Isinyathelo 1: $[\text{H}^+]_A = 10^{-3}\text{ M}$, $[\text{H}^+]_B = 10^{-5}\text{ M}$.
Isinyathelo 2: Isilinganiso $\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-3}}{1.0 \times 10^{-5}} = 10^2 = 100$.
Isinyathelo 3: Ukugcwala kuka-$A$ kukhulu ngokuphindwe ka-100 kune-B.
